liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hard To Handle** (3 reviews): Performance described as a trainwreck due to poor lyrics and timing issues; Beginning was brutal, but the band recovered and cut the song short [7][10][11]

## The recordings

- **gd69-05-16.sbd.clugston.6316.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 7 songs; 50 min; rated 2.65/5 by 20 [1]. Said about its sound: Audio quality is nice, though some sloppiness exists alongside real great jams [4]
- **gd69-05-16.sbd.cotsman.6297.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 5 songs; 52 min; rated 1.75/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is remarkable for a high school gym, sounding like '65 not '69 [14]
- **gd1969-05-16.176807.sbd.gen1.remaster.daniel.flac1644**: soundboard; 5 songs; 52 min [3]

## Around the show

- Rumor claims the entire senior class dosed for the performance at their high school [8]
- A staff member made himself known at the end, possibly upset about the event [9]
- Someone recorded the band in a high school auditorium during their peak years [13]
- Custodian got upset when the band tried to hammer the drumset to the stage [15]
- Contrasted with amazing shows played at The Ark just a few weeks earlier [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-05-16.sbd.clugston.6316.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Soundboard (speed corrected) [1]
- **gd69-05-16.sbd.cotsman.6297.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Paul Hartman and J. Cotsman; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Sound Forge normalized pitch and retracked the recording in conjunction with CD Wave [2]
- **gd1969-05-16.176807.sbd.gen1.remaster.daniel.flac1644**: transferred by remastered by Daniel February 4th, 2026; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Ampex C-90) > gen1 Cassette (TDK SA-X60) > DAT (speed corrected) > CDR > shn [3]. Also: Speed-corrected remaster thanks to Owsley Stanley, Dick Latvala, and Scott Clugston [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Poster from 5/16/69, Campolindo High School, Moraga, CA](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/poster-51669-campolindo-high-school-moraga-ca) [17]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1969-05-16 Fri Campolindo High School, Moraga, CA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1486842508718/grateful-dead-1969-05-16-fri-campolindo) [18]
